capabilities: Embed a terminal as an Obsidian workspace view
Run interactive shells with ANSI color, cursor control, and tab completion
Keep shell sessions alive in the background when the terminal is hidden
Configure the default shell and VS Code-style hotkeys
extras: Linux support is experimental and mobile/web are unsupported; multiple tabs, SSH, and an AI assistant are listed as unfinished roadmap items. README is largely in Chinese with English section summaries.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in terminal, so command-line work like Git, scripts, and CLI tools requires switching to a separate terminal app.
summary: Embedded terminal that runs a real PTY-backed shell (xterm.js + node-pty) inside an Obsidian workspace view.
